file name: jaxb-xjc-4.0.8.jar (shaded: com.sun.xml.bind.external:rngom:4.0.8)
RNGOM is a RelaxNG Object model library (XSOM for RelaxNG).
In Eclipse Glassfish versions before 7.0.17, The Host HTTP parameter could cause the web application to redirect to the specified URL, when the requested endpoint is '/management/domain'. By modifying the URL value to a malicious site, an attacker may successfully launch a phishing scam and steal user credentials.
Not relevant to docx4j.

file name: jaxb-xjc-4.0.8.jar (shaded: com.sun.xml.bind.external:relaxng-datatype:4.0.8)
Same issue as above.

Supressing CVE-2026-23907 and CVE-2026-33929 for pdfbox-io-3.0.7
The ExtractEmbeddedFiles example contains a path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) because the filename that is obtained from PDComplexFileSpecification.getFilename() is appended to the extraction path.
We have determined this is a low risk for docx4j, since this example is not part of our production code.
The core difference is that CVE-2026-33929 is a "bypass" of the fix intended for CVE-2026-23907. While the first fix successfully blocked standard directory traversal sequences (like ../), it failed to account for prefix manipulation, which the second CVE addresses.
CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
CVE-2026-2587 and CVE-2026-2586 are false positives against jaxb-xjc-4.0.8.jar. See block comment above for full rationale.

CVE-2026-2587 and CVE-2026-2586 are false positives against the relaxng-datatype library shaded inside jaxb-xjc-4.0.8.jar (com.sun.xml.bind.external:relaxng-datatype). Dependency-Check erroneously matches version 4.0.8 to the GlassFish CPE. relaxng-datatype is the RelaxNG Datatype library and has no relationship to the vulnerable GlassFish components. See block comment above for full rationale.
